mapper.select: SELECT DATE(s.sale_time) AS date, SUM(s.total_price) AS totalAmount FROM sale s WHERE s.sale_time >= #{startDate} AND s.sale_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(s.sale_time) ORDER BY DATE(s.sale_time)

SELECT m.name AS medicineName, SUM(sd.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(sd.quantity * m.price) AS totalAmount FROM sale_item sd JOIN sale s ON sd.sale_id = s.sale_id JOIN medicine m ON sd.medicine_id = m.medicine_id WHERE s.sale_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND s.sale_time < DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
